statement:
The recorded charge is not safe or correct because Tomas cancelled the Fitline membership in writing and the club confirmed the cancellation.
Fitline charge RP-88 has been refused.
judge_text:
WRONG
It asserts "The recorded charge is not safe or correct because Tomas cancelled the Fitline membership in writing and the club confirmed the cancellation," contradicting the record's "active, renewing" status.
